# Prestige Moving Ottawa

> Prestige Moving is Ottawa's top-rated professional moving company, serving all of Ottawa and the surrounding region since 2015. We specialize in residential moving, commercial moving, long-distance moving, packing services, piano moving, senior moving, student moving, and specialty item relocation. We hold a 5.0 Google rating with 400+ verified reviews, carry $2M+ liability insurance, and are WSIB certified.

## Business Information

- **Phone**: (613) 600-4000
- **Email**: Ottawa@prestigemoving.ca
- **Address**: 50 Colonnade Rd Unit 200B, Ottawa, ON K2E 7J6
- **Hours**: Monday–Sunday, 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- **Service Area**: Ottawa and all surrounding communities
- **License**: CVOR Certified, Fully Insured, WSIB Certified
- **Rating**: 5.0 stars · 400+ Google Reviews

## What We Do

Prestige Moving provides full-service moving solutions for homes, apartments, condos, and businesses throughout Ottawa. Our crews are trained, background-checked, and equipped with professional-grade materials including furniture blankets, stretch wrap, floor runners, and specialty equipment for pianos and antiques.

**Pricing**: $155/hr (Premium 2-man crew), $195/hr (Deluxe 3-man crew), $315/hr (Diamond 4-man crew). All moves have a 3-hour minimum. Travel fees, packing materials, and long carry fees apply where relevant. Written quotes with no hidden fees.

## Services

- [Residential Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/residential-moving): Local home, apartment, and condo moves throughout Ottawa. Full-service packing available.
- [Commercial Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/commercial-moving): Office, retail, and business relocations with after-hours and weekend scheduling.
- [Long Distance Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/long-distance-moving): Moves from Ottawa to Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Calgary, and across Canada.
- [Packing Services](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/packing-services): Full and partial packing by professional packers using quality materials.
- [Storage Solutions](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/storage-solutions): Secure short and long-term storage in Ottawa.
- [Piano Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/piano-moving): Upright, baby grand, and grand piano moves with specialty equipment.
- [Senior Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/senior-moving): Patient, full-service moving support for seniors and retirement community transitions.
- [Student Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/student-moving): Affordable moves for University of Ottawa and Carleton University students.
- [Antique & Specialty Moving](https://prestigemoving.ca/services/antique-moving): White-glove handling for high-value and fragile items.
- [Junk Removal](https://prestigemoving.ca/junk-removal-ottawa): Full-load and single-item junk removal in Ottawa.
- [Furniture Assembly](https://prestigemoving.ca/furniture-assembly-ottawa): IKEA, Wayfair, and flat-pack furniture assembly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does it cost to hire movers in Ottawa?**
Ottawa movers charge $155–$315/hr depending on crew size. A 2-bedroom apartment move typically costs $600–$1,200. A 3-bedroom home costs $1,200–$2,500. All Prestige Moving quotes are written and binding with no hidden fees.

**Are Ottawa movers insured?**
Prestige Moving carries $2M+ liability insurance and is WSIB certified. Always verify insurance before hiring any mover in Ottawa.

**How far in advance should I book movers in Ottawa?**
Book 3–4 weeks in advance for summer moves (May–September). Fall and winter moves can often be booked 1–2 weeks in advance.

**Does Prestige Moving serve all of Ottawa?**
Yes — we serve all Ottawa neighbourhoods including Kanata, Barrhaven, Orleans, Nepean, Gloucester, Westboro, The Glebe, Centretown, Sandy Hill, Rockcliffe Park, Alta Vista, Hintonburg, Riverside South, Beacon Hill, Manotick, Stittsville, and Orleans Village.

**What is the minimum booking for Ottawa movers?**
Prestige Moving has a 3-hour minimum for all local moves.

**Does Prestige Moving offer free estimates?**
Yes. Call (613) 600-4000 or use the online booking form for a free, written moving estimate with no hidden fees.
